faqs.question: What time are check-in and check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is at 12:00 PM. Let us know if your flight arrives late at night — our desk is open 24/7.

faqs.question: Do you provide Bole International Airport pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your flight number in your reservation message and our driver will meet you outside arrivals.

faqs.question: Can I pay in ETB or USD?
faqs.answer: Yes. Room rates default to USD, and guests can settle in USD or the ETB equivalent at the hotel desk.

faqs.question: Do all rooms include Wi-Fi and backup power?
faqs.answer: Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi and full automatic generator backup run across every floor and meeting room.

newsPosts.title: New Bole Conference Wing Open for Group Bookings
newsPosts.excerpt: Two modern meeting halls with high-speed Wi-Fi, projector screens, and coffee catering.
newsPosts.body:
Skyline Hotel has opened two newly furnished conference rooms designed for workshops, diplomatic briefings, and corporate trainings.

Each room supports flexible seating for 20 to 60 participants, fast internet, and full catering breaks with Ethiopian coffee, pastries, and buffet lunch.
newsPosts.author: Selam Tadesse

newsPosts.title: Extended 24-Hour Airport Shuttle for International Flights
newsPosts.excerpt: Midnight arrivals from Addis Ababa Bole Airport now connect straight to our lobby.
newsPosts.body:
Because many international flights land late at night, our hotel shuttle team now operates continuously around the clock.

Guests simply add their airline and arrival time when booking online, and a labeled hotel vehicle waits at arrivals.
newsPosts.author: Biniyam Solomon

newsPosts.title: Monthly Corporate & NGO Stay Rates Now Available
newsPosts.excerpt: Discounted weekly and monthly packages for visiting project teams in Addis Ababa.
newsPosts.body:
Organizations hosting long-term staff or consultants in Bole can now reserve block stays with laundry service, breakfast, and meeting room credits included.

Contact our reservations team directly for tailored corporate invoices.
newsPosts.author: Management Team

blogPosts.title: 48 Hours in Addis Ababa: Food, Coffee & Must-See Stops
blogPosts.excerpt: A simple two-day plan covering Entoto Park, Unity Park, local coffee houses, and evening dining.
blogPosts.body:
Whether you are in Addis Ababa between flights or visiting for work, two days is plenty to experience the city’s best spots.

Start Day 1 at Entoto Natural Park for fresh eucalyptus air and panoramic views, then visit the National Museum to see Lucy. Spend the afternoon at an authentic Tomoca or traditional buna spot before enjoying injera and live cultural music in Bole.
blogPosts.author: Yonas Gebre

blogPosts.title: Bole Arrival Guide: Airport Pickup, SIM Cards & Local Payments
blogPosts.excerpt: Practical arrival answers for guests landing at Addis Ababa Bole International Airport.
blogPosts.body:
Landing late or for the first time in Addis Ababa is simple when you prepare a few basics ahead of time.

Our hotel driver meets guests right outside arrivals. In the morning, our reception team can direct you to nearby Ethio Telecom and Safaricom shops for local SIM cards and bank ATMs within a five-minute walk of the lobby.
blogPosts.author: Meron Assefa

blogPosts.title: Hosting Smooth Meetings & Events in Addis Ababa
blogPosts.excerpt: How hotels in Bole combine meeting rooms, reliable internet, and guest lodging under one roof.
blogPosts.body:
Planning a conference or NGO training works best when participants stay in the same building where sessions happen.

With high-speed Wi-Fi, backup power, coffee breaks featuring freshly roasted Ethiopian coffee, and airport transfers, guests focus on their work while our team runs every detail smoothly.
blogPosts.author: Kalkidan Tesfaye
